build.beforeBuildCommand: cd src-tauri && cargo run --bin bump_version && cd .. && npm --prefix web run build

bundle.shortDescription: Voxril - Local AI Voice Cover Maker for Windows
bundle.longDescription: Voxril turns any song into a cover sung in your own voice, fully offline. Train a voice model from a few minutes of audio, separate vocals, convert them, and export the finished cover. Powered by RVC.
